historical_result_oos.note: resultado HISTÓRICO; não aprova a estratégia

indicators.mean: arithmetic mean of last 20 CLOSED candle closes
indicators.std: POPULATION standard deviation (divide by 20) of the same 20 closes

entry_rule.signal_at: close of each 5m candle (bucket boundary, Binance kline closed=true)

horizon.definition: 5 candles of 5m; exposure is 25 MINUTES, not 5
horizon.settlement: close of the candle 5 buckets after the signal candle

overlaps: allowed but tracked (see eval: effective sample size via block bootstrap)
not_to_confuse_with: Binary V3 300-second expiry — distinct experiment, untouched

evaluation_protocol.entry_price: first executable price AFTER the signal (ask for UP, bid for DOWN) from bookTicker
evaluation_protocol.costs: taker fee 0.1% per leg (Binance spot), slippage documented per trade
evaluation_protocol.ev_net: payout 0.85 binary proxy on direction hit minus full costs, AND spot EV after fees
evaluation_protocol.baseline: random direction with same cost model
evaluation_protocol.inference: block bootstrap (block length 12 candles = 1h) for CI of WR and EV; effective sample size from overlap count
evaluation_protocol.immutability: signals ledger is hash-chained (each record includes sha256 of previous)

prohibition: NO real orders, NO PRACTICE orders. Read-only market data only.
